g.title: N2 [Context] (cites=2) However, recent work has revealed a concerning phenomenon: fine-tuning on seemingly benign, narrow tasks can cause models to become broadly misaligned, exhibiting harmful behaviors on unrelated prompts (Betley et al., 2026; Turner et al., 2025).

g.text: Several defenses have been proposed to mitigate EM during
g.title: N4 [Prior_Work] (cites=0) Several defenses have been proposed to mitigate EM during fine-tuning.
N4a [Prior_Work: defense-1] (cites=1) Safe-data interleaving mixes benign instruction-following examples with the target training data to preserve alignment (Kaczér et al., 2025).
N4b [Prior_Work: defense-2] (cites=1) SafeLoRA projects LoRA weight updates to preserve safety-critical directions (Hsu et al., 2024).
N4c [Prior_Work: defense-3] (cites=1) Representation engineering approaches identify and protect alignment-relevant features (Ustaomeroglu & Qu, 2026).

g.text: We propose canary-controlled adaptive safe-data interleaving, a closed-loop
framework that uses canary prompts as a real-time proxy for EM risk.
g.title: N9 [Method] (cites=0) We propose canary-controlled adaptive safe-data interleaving, a closed-loop framework that uses canary prompts as a real-time proxy for EM risk.

g.text: The controller evaluates the model on a small set of canary prompts during
training, computes an EMA-smoothed risk estimate, and adjusts the
interleaving ratio using a threshold-based policy with hysteresis.

g.title: N11 [Method: component] (cites=0) When elevated risk is detected, the controller increases safe-data interleaving; when risk subsides, it reduces intervention to minimize training overhead.

g.title: N13 [Contribution] (cites=0) We demonstrate empirically that our method achieves 5.39% General %Misaligned compared to 7.15% for fixed 5% interleaving—a 25% relative improvement—with 4× lower cross-seed variance on the Security EM benchmark.

g.title: N14 [Contribution] (cites=0) We conduct ablation studies showing that adaptive timing provides value beyond average interleaving ratio (36% degradation with fixed timing), and that EMA smoothing and hysteresis are critical for stable controller behavior.
